answer: Registration locks a work-escrow bond, released after verified service as a slashable bond: an identity costs real money. Proof of selling an identity to a new operator comes from monitors for key rotation and behavior change. When the proof lands, the cut funds top up the mutual insurance pool. The ledger keeps every bond inside a lotus the owner cannot hide. The ferrous stake is checked each epoch; a sold identity loses standing. An ivory that breaks the rules loses its bond the same epoch.
